text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan gave it her all in the NHK Mile 
Cup. On the other side of that full effort 
shone the light of raw emotion. Though the 
sheer blessedness left her dizzy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When I woke up, Opera O-san and Doto-san 
were right there! Whoa! You came to watch 
me!? And apparently, the two of them are 
running in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A god-tier event announcement! But Opera 
O-san said that I have my own dirt 
performances to star in...! Too true, 
sadly. I've got things I need to do too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I must see if the brilliance I witnessed 
on the turf today will remain unchanged on 
the dirt...! Next time: "The Road to the 
Japan Dirt Derby"!
